infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aura uses the camera to take photos for your stories and chat messages. A photo is only sent when you choose to share it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aura lets you choose an existing photo for your profile picture, a story, or a chat message. Only the photo you pick is shared — Aura never reads your library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Aura keeps looking for nearby people and sound zones while the app is closed, so you are told about someone near you without having to open it. This is optional — everything works while the app is open without it.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Aura keeps looking for nearby people and sound zones while the app is closed, so you are told about someone near you without having to open it. This is optional — everything works while the app is open without it.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Aura shows you people within about 500m who share your interests, and places you on the map so they can find you. You choose whether your position is exact or rounded to a ~500m area, and you can pause sharing at any time in Settings.

plugins.cameraPermission: Aura uses the camera to take photos for your stories and chat messages. A photo is only sent when you choose to share it.
plugins.photosPermission: Aura lets you choose an existing photo for your profile picture, a story, or a chat message. Only the photo you pick is shared — Aura never reads your library.
